# {{ site.name }}

> Personal site of Vladimir Ilievski (Vlad), data scientist and creator of iSquared. In-depth tutorials with interactive visualizations and runnable Python code, focused on machine learning, generative models, stochastic processes (Brownian motion, random walks, fractals), data visualization tooling, and developer productivity tips.

## About
- [$whoami — Vladimir Ilievski]({{ "/whoami/" | absolute_url }}): Bio, background, talks, and publications of the author. Data scientist by day, content creator by night; author of iSquared.
